scripts.build: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" -r run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" -r run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" -r run lint && pnpm run format:check
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "apps/**/*" "packages/**/*" contracts/*.json package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json --end-of-line auto
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" -r run test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @models-roundtable/db run test:integration
